provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Witcher: Path of Destiny rulebook (Go On Board, via RulesPal)

modules.name: The Edge of the World
modules.note: Easiest; for a first game skip Extra Effort cards and Side Quests.

steps.text: Playmat on the table with room for each Player board and Timeline
Tale card deck on its spot, cover faceup like a book
Destiny and Path tokens by the Tale cards: Destiny III at the bottom, II, then I on top
Shuffle the Main deck facedown; a faceup pair of cards on each of {n} rows
Extra Experience token next to the bottom available row
Whoever last read a Witcher book picks first: shuffle Player boards facedown, take 2, keep 1, return 1; clockwise
Regular Experience marker on 0; Golden marker on the spot shown right of the track
1 Ability token active side up on the leftmost Ability; the other 3 beside the board
Standees on the Initiative track in the Tale's order (highest closest to the Tale cards)
One Player token on 0 of the Victory Point track
Your 5 starting Action cards as your hand; Side Quest card tucked faceup under your board
Automa board of a remaining character as the second player; its Experience markers and VP token as normal
Solo Mode Destiny token nearby; box the Automa character's other components
Finish setup with the chosen Tale's own section in the rulebook
Turn over the first Tale card and read the introduction
